title: Evaluation and ring homomorphisms
statement: Let $R$ and $S$ be commutative rings, let $f:R\to S$ be a ring homomorphism, and let $C$ be a finite arithmetic circuit on $n$ inputs. For every input $x\in R^n$, applying $f$ to the circuit's value at $x$ gives the value of the same circuit at the input obtained by applying $f$ coordinatewise: $f(C(x))=C(f\circ x)$.
